tools.name: evaluate_portfolio_alignment
tools.description: Compare a clean mandate with normalized holdings. Do not send PDF, CSV, spreadsheet, or factsheet files; extract them before calling.

tools.name: calculate_portfolio_constraints
tools.description: Calculate explicit portfolio constraints deterministically from normalized holdings. Use this for arithmetic checks, not for interpreting natural-language mandates.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "evaluate_portfolio_alignment" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Compare a clean mandate with normalized holdings. Do not send PDF, CSV, spreadsheet, or factsheet files; extract them before calling.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
